summary: SIP servers can become overloaded, and the basic 503 response does not protect them well. This document defines the behavior of SIP servers involved in overload control and specifies a loss-based scheme in which servers tell upstream senders how much traffic to reduce.

eli5.summary: When a restaurant is too full, the host tells arriving groups to wait. This RFC gives phone-call servers a way to tell others to send fewer requests so they do not get swamped.

questions: how do sip servers handle overload
